package.name: dspace
package.author: SWIGroup
package.notes:
Sample dataset from the DSpace Semantic Search testbed platform. Data are made available by the Linked Data Provider component. The dataset includes a series of conference publications and their metadata, which are 'semantified' by transforming to an OWL 2 ontology. 
The project is maintained by the Semantic Web and Interoperability Group (SWIG), HPCLab, Computering Engineering and Informatics Dpt, University of Patras and is available at: http://code.google.com/p/dspace-semantic-search/
